However, all the crazy timelines, paradoxes, and parallel realities weren’t there just to be an interesting puzzle. They were used as a way to explore some complex and relevant themes. In this video, we dive into that side of the series. We look at the series as a whole, how it ended, and offer an interpretation of what it all means. After watching, make sure to share your interpretation and takeaways from the series! This video offers my view and opinions but with a show as complex as DARK, there is so much room for debate.
